description: This file defines the AnonymousSignature class which implements the SignatureInterface for the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to sign requests and presign requests without adding any signature, allowing anonymous access.

classes.name: AnonymousSignature
classes.description: Provides anonymous client access by implementing SignatureInterface, returning the request unchanged in signRequest and presign methods.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Returns the request unmodified, providing anonymous signing functionality.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Returns the request unmodified, used for presigning URLs without signing.

calls: RequestInterface:: (none explicitly called; methods are returning the request object itself)
